One is a type-alias-object declared in 'RadioPlayer.swift' and the other is an extension on that same type declared in 'RadioPlayer+AudioPlayerProtocol.swift'. This is the standard Swift pattern of splitting a type's conformances into separate '+Protocol' extension files; the name collision is intentional and load-bearing, not a duplication to be resolved.
